title: See More on a Bike!
text: This was an excellent way to cover lots of ground and get a great tour of the city highlights. Our guide Constanza was lovely! She was friendly, knowledgeable, professional and caring. (We have gone on lots of tours with guides and our expectations are high!) Seville is flat and the riding was easy. -Anne and Paul from Canada
author: annemW5991JY

title: Wonderful and fun bike tour of Seville
text: My bike tour of Seville with Cosdanza was EXCELLENT!  The pace was nice and we visited many of the important highlights.  Cosdanza was very knowledgeable of the history and culture.  I learned so much about this wonderful city.  Cosdanza is very nice and we actually had fun during the tour (not boring 😁).  I would highly recommend this activity when visiting Seville!
author: W3708TBstevens

title: Would recommend. Ask for NICO
text: Fabulous time touring Seville with Nico. Definitely an experience to remember. Gave us some great insights into the history of Seville, Bull fighting and Flamenco Dancing.
author: Malcolm_A

title: Wonderful bicycle tour
text:
That’s actually my best tour experience in Seville. It started at 4pm but it was not hot, in my opinion. We covered a lot of grounds: 
* Tobacco factory Fabrica Real de Tabacos 
* Figus Marcrophylla/Byron Fig three jardin de marialuisa 
* Palaceo de San Telmo
* Golden Tower/Torre Del Oro connected to the Alcazar used for escaping during emergency (siege, fire, rebellion)
* Victoria fits 40-60 people
* Realis atarazanas bull ring
* La Plaza de San Francisco
author: YoklimAbel_L

title: Informative and fun
text: Friendly, fun, and insightful about the history of Seville, highly recommend for anyone who wants to see a lot of Seville in a short time period and the history of this beautiful City
